encode_bboxes_to_buckets: encode proposal bboxes and ground truth bboxes into bucketing estimation and fine regression targets using BucketingBBoxCoder
decode_buckets_to_bboxes: decode bucketing classification predictions and offset predictions back to decoded bboxes with localization confidence
generate_buckets_from_proposals: generate left, right, top, and down buckets from proposal boxes given a bucket count and scale factor
bbox_to_bucket_targets: compute bucket labels, offset targets, and classification weights from proposals and ground truth boxes for SABL training
bucket_to_bbox_decode: apply bucketing classification and fine regression predictions to generate final detection bboxes with border clipping
